scope: Theorem 7.5 (Symmetric-jet criterion) of the manuscript “Contact Fano manifolds and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture” (preprints/Contact-Fano-manifolds-and-the-LeBrun-Salamon-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 062 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c7ef1ec44ffd8d7a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a connected compact complex contact manifold with contact quotient θ : TX → L, and let I∆ be the ideal sheaf of the diagonal in X × X. Suppose that a symmetric section B ∈ H0(X × X, L ⊠ L) satisfies B ∈ H0 (X × X, I2 ∆ ⊗ (L ⊠ L)), [B]2 = θ2 in H0 (X, Sym2 Ω1 X ⊗ L⊗2 ). Then the ordinary first-jet evaluation map H0 (X, L) −→ J1 xL (7.8) is surjective at every x ∈ X. Global contact vector fields span TxX at every point, and the identity component of the holomorphic contact automorphism group acts transitively.
